lines.en: I move through the woods at a low crouch.
My claws snap plenty of dead twigs.
I walk leaning my body forward.
Trunks brush against my shoulders.
I'm hunting a scent through the trees.
My tail sweeps the brush aside.
I set each step down quietly.
Tree shadows flicker along my back.
I've taken a short cut.

lines.zh: 我从两棵大树之间挤过。
lines.en: I squeeze between two large trunks.
I stop and listen to the wind.
I head deeper in again.
My skull is heavy.
Head down, tail straight.
I rest in a clearing.
I lower my heavy skull.
The woods are full of insects.
My two forelimbs are nearly useless.
I'm deciding which way to go.
There's dew on the leaves.
My claws scrape the ground.
I hold my breath and listen.
The ridges along my back are deep.
I'm waiting for a scent to drift by.
I twist my head the other way.
Light leaks through the canopy.
My breathing is rough and heavy.
The soil underfoot is damp.
I raise my head and look at you.
You're not tall, and not fast enough.
The scent of you is very alive.
My teeth aren't very neat.
You're backing behind a tree.
I tilt my heavy head.
I'm counting how often you breathe.
I'm judging how far you are.
I've lifted one claw.
I stepped back and roared.
That knocked me off balance.
A gash has split my hide open.
I shake my head and blood flies.
I drop low and reassess.
I can take this much.
I slipped and steadied again.
My claws dig into the soil.
I'm not about to run.
That thing isn't alive.
What are you doing with that?
The smell is nearly nothing.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子更好用的是血味。
lines.en: My nose works better on the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 你手上那点不够我一口。
lines.en: That in your hand is not one mouthful.
I push my snout over to sniff.
I've no interest in that.
It's sitting between you and me.

lines.zh: 这肉不新鲜，我用爪拨开。
lines.en: This meat is not fresh; I push it aside with a claw.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上又弹回去。
lines.en: You hit my leg and bounced back.
My whole body didn't shift.
The recoil knocked you down.
We broke a branch between us.

lines.zh: 我的胸膛撞得你退了三步。
lines.en: My chest knocks you back three steps.
That force was nothing at all.
I drop my head to examine you.
Your shoulder is shaking. Stop it.
I've turned my body against you.
Ten more tries won't help.
You go ahead; I'll follow.
Your skull is smaller than mine.
Hunting together is easier.
Our ground is at the treeline.
Our own kind smells unmistakable.
We needn't press against each other.
There was a sound on your side.
Then let's go together.
Teeth won't open this.
One step grinds it to pieces.
You dropped this on the ground.
It smells of blood.
I flick it aside with a claw.
I tossed it into the brush.
I've no appetite for that.

lines.zh: 新鲜的肉，得先叼回巢里。
lines.en: Fresh meat, I'll drag it back to the nest first.
I nail my gaze to you.
That movement of yours was foolish.
You're running the wrong way.
I'm charging in low.
All my claws have opened.

lines.zh: 你在往长着苔的坡上跑。
lines.en: You're running for the mossy slope.
That slope is far too slippery.
I'm pressing in slowly.

lines.zh: 你的脚步我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: I hear your every footstep.
My side is all in readiness.
This can begin now.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面慢慢往前走。
lines.en: I move forward low to the ground.
My tail brushes the fallen leaves.
You're hiding behind a trunk.
I slowly work around the side.
I lower my neck a little.
That gully won't stop me.
My claws come down lightly.
I'm at this distance now.
I arch my spine up.
I lower my neck slowly.
You've turned and started running.
Chasing you isn't hard at all.
My last few steps are slow.
I've come this far.
My claws rake your chest.
You're knocked into the brush.
That lunge put my whole weight in.
My first strike was stopped by you.
I bite down from above again.
Your armor has been torn open.
I step back to come again.
You've rolled to the tree roots.
My tail strikes your flank.
That blow was very heavy.
You're still fighting to stand.
I've raised a foreclaw.

lines.zh: 你退到了一块石头后面。
lines.en: You've slipped behind a rock.
That rock is too small.
This is the moment to strike.
I stepped out from among the trees.
The canopy blocks half the sunlight.
I shake the leaves off me.
My skull feels very heavy.
I paused at the treeline.
I raise my heavy skull.
The birds have suddenly gone quiet.
I stretch out my claws.
One foot sinks into soft soil.
I begin to lower my body.
I move through the brush.
I've trampled out a new path.
Something stirs in the distance.
Flame licked at my flank.
Water drives up into my nostrils.
The blast knocked me askew.

lines.zh: 箭尾还在晃，我甩头去咬。
lines.en: The arrow still quivers; I snap at it.
There's little prey in these woods.
The bolt slammed into my spine.

lines.zh: 森林里的我，六十五点生命。
lines.en: In the forest, sixty-five health.
